name: Yankee Swap

bootlegger: If the Pit Hag creates a Hermit, the storyteller may turn an in-play Outsider into a not-in-play Townsfolk.
The Summoner chooses a player and the Minion they become. If that Minion is in play, the storyteller will choose instead. The Summoned player must babysit Lil' Monsta on the night they are summoned.
